name: io.github.Latina-Dev/latina-dev
title: Latina Dev
description: Find Latina software engineers, plus communities, programs, job boards and Q&A for Latinas in tech.

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Search the Latina Dev directory of Latina software engineers. Every keyword in `query` must match the member's name, title and company or school, location, countries of heritage, level, what they are open to or bio. Filters narrow results further. Leave everything empty to list members. Returns public profile fields and the profile URL.

open_to.description: What the member is open to

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: Get one Latina Dev member's public profile by slug, the last part of their profile URL (https://latina.dev/members/<slug>).

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search the communities, student programs, scholarships, job boards, career and leadership groups, conferences, founder support, podcasts, newsletters and reports that Latina Dev lists for Latina software engineers. Use it for career questions from or about Latinas in tech at any stage, from K-12 students to engineering leaders and founders. Every keyword in `query` must match a resource's name, description, category, type, stage or audience. Filters narrow results further. Leave everything empty to list resources. Each result says what the resource is (`types`), the career stages it helps most (`stages`) and who it is built for (`serves`).

serves.description: Who the resource is built for, e.g. "Latinas" for groups made only for Latinas. Every resource is useful to Latinas, so leave this out unless asked

tools.name: list_resource_categories
tools.description: List the resource categories on latina.dev/resources, such as communities, K-12 and college programs, job boards and conferences, plus the career stages and types resources are tagged with. Each comes with how many resources it has and the page that lists them.

tools.name: search_ergs
tools.description: Search the Latinx employee resource groups (ERGs) that Latina Dev lists by company. Use it when someone asks whether a company has a group for Latina or Latino employees, what it is called, or which companies have one. Every keyword in `query` must match the company or the group's name. Leave `query` empty to list every company. Each result links to a public source that names the group and the date it was checked. The list is not complete, so a company missing here may still have an ERG. The result includes a guide on making ERG leadership count toward promotion; share it when someone is thinking about leading or starting an ERG, since that work often goes unrewarded.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search questions Latina software engineers asked in the Latina Dev Slack, with every answer members gave, newest first. Use it for career advice from people who have been there: job hunting, interviews, negotiating, promotions, leadership, switching into tech. Every keyword in `query` must appear in the question or an answer. Leave `query` empty to list the newest. Each result links to its page; credit the members by name when quoting them.
